options: Training a model from scratch on general web data
Removing layers from a pretrained model to make it smaller
Continuing training of a pretrained model on specialized data from a particular field
Translating the model interface into a specific language
questions.explanation: Domain-specific fine-tuning adapts a pretrained foundation model by training it further on data from a specialized domain (e.g., medical, legal, financial), improving its performance on domain tasks.

questions.text: What is curriculum learning in the context of fine-tuning?
options: Randomly shuffling training data at every epoch
Ordering training data from simpler to more complex examples to improve learning
Using only the hardest examples for training
A syllabus for a university course on machine learning
questions.explanation: Curriculum learning presents training examples in order of increasing difficulty, mimicking how humans learn. This can lead to faster convergence and better generalization.

questions.text: How does LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) reduce fine-tuning cost?
options: It freezes the original weights and trains small low-rank matrices injected into each layer
It deletes half of the model’s layers before training
It uses FP64 precision for all calculations
It trains only the embedding layer and freezes everything else
questions.explanation: LoRA keeps the original pretrained weights frozen and adds small trainable low-rank decomposition matrices (A and B) to attention layers, dramatically reducing the number of trainable parameters.

questions.text: What are advantages of LoRA adapter composition?Select all that apply
options: Multiple task-specific adapters can be swapped or merged without retraining the base model
It eliminates the need for any training data
It guarantees zero loss in quality compared to full fine-tuning
Adapters are small files that can be stored and deployed independently from the base model
questions.explanation: LoRA adapters are tiny (often megabytes) compared to the full model (gigabytes). Multiple adapters for different tasks can be hot-swapped or combined at inference time without touching the base weights.

questions.text: What risk does domain-specific fine-tuning introduce if the dataset is too narrow?
options: The model becomes faster at inference
The model’s vocabulary automatically expands
The model improves on all general benchmarks
Catastrophic forgetting, where the model loses general capabilities it had before fine-tuning
questions.explanation: Fine-tuning on a narrow dataset can cause catastrophic forgetting, where the model overwrites its broad pretrained knowledge and loses the ability to handle tasks outside the narrow domain.
